henry-billing: quick heads-up — Sunridge Therapeutics (SRG-77) invoice INV-9410 for $8,900 USD failed: card declined and ACH microdeposits pending. They asked for wire but are in CAN (CAD). Can we accept CAD wires or need USD SWIFT?
finance-bot: retry attempt #1 at 2026-06-18T10:05Z — result: FAILED (card_declined). ACH microdeposits not confirmed.
leah-csm: customer prefers CAD credit to their Canadian bank; CFO wants same-day so they can reconcile month-end. They can provide scanned signed wire form.
santosh-finops: policy: we can accept foreign currency wires if ops confirms FX route. For <$10k no finance board approval needed, but ops must confirm payout rails and fees. @olivia-ops can you confirm whether we can send CAD to their bank or need USD SWIFT?
olivia-ops: we can execute CAD via our CDN partner (local Canadian clearing) if beneficiary bank supports it. Need their bank institution number + transit number. If they only provide IBAN/SWIFT, we'll send USD via SWIFT with beneficiary conversion fees. Share the template for them to fill.
henry-billing: sending them the short wire form and request for Canadian routing details. Holding a last card retry until 10:30 PT. If no CAD details by then, offer USD SWIFT and note fees.
leah-csm: customer replied they can provide Canadian transit/routing within 10 minutes. Uploading scanned form when received.
